newsitem.title: USA: Orbital Sciences posts record backlog.
newsitem.headline: Orbital Sciences posts record backlog.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Inc said on Wednesday its contract backlog reached an all-time high in the third quarter.

The company said firm backlog was about $675 million at September 30 compared with $530 million at December 31, 1995. Total order backlog, including firm backlog and option orders not yet exercised, slightly exceeded $2 billion at September 30, up 33 percent from December 31, 1995, it said.

"Orbital continued its outstanding financial and operational performance in the third quarter, achieving all-time record revenues, backlog and earnings," said President and Chief Executive Officer David Thompson.
